name: @w6w-apps/aweber
description: Manage AWeber email lists, subscribers and broadcasts — add and update subscribers, read and schedule broadcast newsletters, and manage tags and custom fields.

w6w.longDescription:
AWeber is an email marketing and newsletter platform built around Lists, Subscribers and Broadcasts. This app covers the API's full v1 surface for those three resources: reading and finding lists, adding, finding, updating, moving and removing subscribers (by ID or by email), tracking e-commerce purchases against a subscriber, and creating, updating, scheduling, cancelling and reading the open/click stats of broadcast newsletters. It also covers list-scoped Tags, Custom Fields and Segments, and the account-level resources every call is scoped under.

Authorization is OAuth 2.0 (AWeber's older OAuth 1.0a is still accepted by the API but is not implemented here — see the README). Health checks track AWeber's own status page alongside the credential's own liveness.
